result.justification: The research objective of investigating immune imprinting is clear, as is the methodology, which includes detailed experimental procedures and analytical techniques.

objective_evidence.quote: Here, we investigate immune imprinting by comparing phage-display antibody libraries from WT-infected convalescents in early 2020 (WT-AbLib) and Omicron-infected convalescents in early 2023 (Omi-AbLib).

method_evidence.quote: The construction and screening of the phage antibody library followed previously established methods.
